Tres papeles esperan: Three pieces of paper are waiting
Andrés mira dos: Andres looks at two of them
espera en la buseta: waits in the small city bus
Andrés mira el torniquete y duda: Andres looks at the turnstile and hesitates
pero mi cara va lejos: but my face is going far
Esta buseta para en el andencito: This bus stops at the little sidewalk
La panadera trae un pandebono: The baker brings a cheese bread roll
La médica cruza por la cebra: The doctor crosses at the crosswalk
mira el carril y aprieta el cordón: looks at the lane and squeezes the cord
Camilo pega el papel en la placa: Camilo sticks the paper on the sign panel
Escribe Andrés grande: He writes Andres in big letters
Prende la lucecita: He turns on the little light
limpia el retrovisor y mira la calzada: cleans the rear-view mirror and looks at the roadway
La baldosa queda clara: The paving tile is easy to see
Ahora Andrés sabe dónde bajar: Now Andres knows where to get off
La buseta para suave y sin frenazo: The bus stops gently and with no hard braking
la manija y el baúl: the door handle and the luggage compartment
Aquí bajo yo: This is where I get off
Yo aviso en el andencito: I will call out at the sidewalk
Él camina a la mesa correcta: He walks to the right table
